settings.label: Enable cart upsell
settings.info: Shows cross-sell recommendations in the cart drawer and on the cart page.

settings.label: Upsell collection
settings.info: Recommendations are picked from this collection. Only the first 50 products of the collection are considered.

settings.label: Fill remaining slots with random products
settings.info: When there are fewer exact title matches than the number of recommendations, the remaining slots are filled with random available products from the upsell collection. Turn off to show exact matches only.
